recognize_zh: 高倍放大硫磺顆粒內部：嗜伊紅纖維狀基質中交錯著許多極細的絲狀結構，部分區域呈藍紫色放射狀排列，並夾雜細長透明裂隙；邊緣下方可見嗜中性球。這種由細絲狀菌交織而成的菌落，是放線菌（Actinomyces）硫磺顆粒的高倍表現。
features: Dense eosinophilic, finely fibrillary matrix composed of interlacing delicate filaments
Basophilic zones of thin radiating filaments forming starburst-like foci
Numerous slit-like and needle-shaped clear clefts within the granule
Rim of neutrophils and red cells along the lower edge of the granule
Single small golden-brown hemosiderin granule within the colony
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows the interior of a large bacterial granule. The granule consists of a dense eosinophilic, finely fibrillary matrix of interlacing delicate filaments, with basophilic foci of radiating filaments and numerous slit-like clear clefts. A rim of neutrophils and red cells borders the lower edge, and a small golden-brown hemosiderin granule is present. Individual branching filaments are better demonstrated with Gram and GMS stains. Findings are consistent with a sulfur granule of actinomycosis.

ddx.vs: Nocardia seldom forms compact granules, and its beaded branching filaments are modified acid-fast positive, unlike Actinomyces.
Granules are composed of cocci or short bacilli rather than long thin branching filaments on Gram stain.
Fungal grains contain broad septate hyphae 3-5 um wide with chlamydospores, much thicker than the <1 um bacterial filaments.
Fibrin and collagen lack radiating basophilic filaments and a surrounding neutrophilic rim, and are Gram-negative.
